title: Hemothorax
summary: A rifleman was hit in the right chest by a round that went through his plate carrier. He is short of breath and his chest is filling with blood. You have TXA and a thoracostomy kit.
objectives: Gain access and give TXA early: it is what lets a large hemothorax clot
Thoracostomy, chest tube and drain the blood; drain again if it builds up
Keep the chest tube sealed: a patient treated while unconscious stays lying; one who gets up unseals the tube (re-seal it)
Patient alive with SpO2 above 90 % at the end
